# Dynamic library blocks

These reusable blocks are the building units for dynamic device models and the RMS and EMT graphical model editors.

## Documented blocks

The pages in this section describe the library blocks by name, including signal-processing, control, electrical, lookup, limiter, switching, and unit-conversion blocks.

```{toctree}
:maxdepth: 1
:glob:

*
```

## Editor block catalogue

The editor catalogue is generated from the block descriptors used by VeraGrid. It exposes the precise symbolic interface and characteristic equations for every editor-ready catalogue entry.

```{toctree}
:maxdepth: 2

catalog/index
```
